items.title: Brian Robinson: Ruled out for Sunday's game
items.description:
Robinson (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

items.title: Justice Hill: Season-high rushing yardage total
items.description:
Hill rushed nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for seven yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.

items.title: Joe Fagnano: Modest numbers in starting role
items.description:
